You have life before you. Once only you can live it. What is the noblest object of desire, the supreme gift to covet?

arxiv-2109-11059.title: Exploring Heterogeneous Metadata for Video Recommendation with Two-tower Model DOI: 10.475/123_4 ISBN: 123-4567-24-567/08/06 Conference: ACM Woodstock conference; July 1997; El Paso, Texas USA 4 Price: 15.00
arxiv-2109-11059.creator: Jianling Wang, Ainur Yessenalina, Alireza Roshan-Ghias
arxiv-2109-11059.description: Abstract . Online video services acquire new content on a daily basis to increase engagement, and improve the user experience. Traditional recommender systems solely rely on watch history, delaying the recommendation of newly added titles to the right customer. However, one can use the metadata information of a cold-start title to bootstrap the personalization.

arxiv-2112-07980.title: Data Placement for Multi-Tenant Data Federation on the Cloud
arxiv-2112-07980.creator: Ji Liu 2 9 1, Lei Mo 2 3, Sijia Yang 4, Jingbo Zhou 5, Shilei Ji 6, Haoyi Xiong 9, and Dejing Dou 9
arxiv-2112-07980.description: Abstract Due to privacy concerns of users and law enforcement in data security and privacy, it becomes more and more difficult to share data among organizations. Data federation brings new opportunities to the data-related cooperation among organizations by providing abstract data interfaces.

arxiv-2310-20345.title: Variational formalism for the Klein-Gordon oscillon
arxiv-2310-20345.creator: I. V. Barashenkov and N. V. Alexeeva
arxiv-2310-20345.description: Abstract The variational method employing the amplitude and width as collective coordinates of the Klein-Gordon oscillon leads to a dynamical system with unstable periodic orbits that blow up when perturbed. We propose a multiscale variational approach free from the blow-up singularities.

arxiv-2312-03173.title: A Comparative Study of AI-Generated (GPT-4) and Human-crafted MCQs in Programming Education Conference: Australian Computing Education Conference; January 29-February 2, 2024; Sydney, NSW, Australia Australian Computing Education Conference (ACE 2024), January 29-February 2, 2024, Sydney, NSW, Austr

arxiv-2312-03173.description: Abstract . There is a constant need for educators to develop and maintain effective up-to-date assessments. While there is a growing body of research in computing education on utilizing large language models (LLMs) in generation and engagement with coding exercises, the use of LLMs for generating programming MCQs has not been extensively explored.

arxiv-2401-15270.title: SimFair: Physics-Guided Fairness-Aware Learning with Simulation Models
arxiv-2401-15270.creator: Zhihao Wang, Yiqun Xie, Zhili Li, Xiaowei Jia, Zhe Jiang, Aolin Jia, Shuo Xu
arxiv-2401-15270.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhihao Wang, Yiqun Xie, Zhili Li, Xiaowei Jia, Zhe Jiang, Aolin Jia, Shuo Xu. Fairness-awareness has emerged as an essential building block for the responsible use of artificial intelligence in real applications. In many cases, inequity in performance is due to the change in distribution over different regions. While techniques have been developed to improve the transferability of fairness, a solution to the problem is not always feasible with no samples from the new regions, which is a bottleneck for pure data-driven attempts.

arxiv-2403-17487.title: Greybody Factors Imprinted on Black Hole Ringdowns. II. Merging Binary Black Holes Preprint: YITP-24-35, RIKEN-iTHEMS-Report-24
arxiv-2403-17487.creator: Kazumasa Okabayashi 1, Naritaka Oshita 1,2,3
arxiv-2403-17487.description: Abstract The spectral amplitude of the merger-ringdown gravitational wave (GW) emitted by a comparable mass-ratio black hole merger is modeled by the greybody factor of the remnant black hole. We also include the post-Newtonian correction to the greybody factor model. Our model includes only a few fitting parameters, which could evade the overfitting issue.

arxiv-2504-07134.title: Bringing Attention to CAD: Boundary Representation Learning via Transformer
arxiv-2504-07134.creator: Qiang Zou, Lizhen Zhu
arxiv-2504-07134.description: Abstract The recent rise of generative artificial intelligence (AI), powered by Transformer networks, has achieved remarkable success in natural language processing, computer vision, and graphics. However, the application of Transformers in computer-aided design (CAD), particularly for processing boundary representation (B-rep) models, remains largely unexplored.

arxiv-2511-17623.title: M 2 OE 2 -GL: A Family of Probabilistic Load Forecasters That Scales to Massive Customers
arxiv-2511-17623.creator: Haoran Li, Zhe Cheng, Muhao Guo, Yang Weng, Yannan Sun, Victor Tran, John Chainaranont
arxiv-2511-17623.description: Abstract Probabilistic load forecasting is widely investigated, laying the foundations for power system planning, operation, and risk-aware decision-making. In particular, deep learning–based forecasters have shown a strong ability to capture complex temporal and contextual patterns, achieving substantial gains in accuracy.

arxiv-2512-09810.title: Incorporating Fairness in Neighborhood Graphs for Fair Spectral Clustering
arxiv-2512-09810.creator: Adithya K Moorthy, V. Vijaya Saradhi, Bhanu Prasad
arxiv-2512-09810.description: Abstract Graph clustering plays a pivotal role in unsupervised learning methods like spectral clustering, yet traditional methods for graph clustering often perpetuate bias through unfair graph constructions that may underrepresent some groups. The current research introduces novel approaches for constructing fair k-nearest neighbor (kNN) and fair ϵ \epsilon -neighborhood graphs that proactively enforce demographic parity during graph formation.

pmc-10696034.creator: Maryam Davarzani, Sasan Aliniaeifard, Mahboobeh Zare Mehrjerdi, Mahmood Reza Roozban, Seyyed Arash Saeedi, Nazim S Gruda

Nowadays, replacing traditional lighting sources with LEDs attracted lots of attention.

pmc-11302312.creator: Abhimanyu Sud, Chloe Campbell, Arani Sivakumar, Ross Upshur, Rahim Moineddin, Kellia Chiu

There have been few evaluations of such policy interventions and understanding effects can help policy planning across jurisdictions.

pmc-11426049.title: Cell-targeted gene modification by delivery of CRISPR-Cas9 ribonucleoprotein complexes in pseudotyped lentivirus-derived nanoparticles
pmc-11426049.creator: Ian Helstrup Nielsen, Anne Bruun Rovsing, Jacob Hørlück Janns, Emil Aagaard Thomsen, Albert Ruzo, Andreas Bøggild, Frederikke Nedergaard, Charlotte Thornild Møller, Thomas Boesen, Søren Egedal Degn, Jagesh V Shah, Jacob Giehm Mikkelsen
pmc-11426049.description: To fully utilize the potential of CRISPR-Cas9-mediated genome editing, time-restricted and targeted delivery is crucial. By modulating the pseudotype of engineered lentivirus-derived nanoparticles (LVNPs), we demonstrate efficient cell-targeted delivery of Cas9/single guide RNA (sgRNA) ribonucleoprotein (RNP) complexes, supporting gene modification in a defined subset of cells in mixed cell populations.

pmc-11676947.title: A multi-scale study of thalamic state-dependent responsiveness
pmc-11676947.creator: Jorin Overwiening, Federico Tesler, Domenico Guarino, Alain Destexhe, Jonathan David Touboul, Daniele Marinazzo, Jonathan David Touboul, Daniele Marinazzo, Jonathan David Touboul, Daniele Marinazzo, Jonathan David Touboul, Daniele Marinazzo
pmc-11676947.description: The thalamus is the brain’s central relay station, orchestrating sensory processing and cognitive functions. However, how thalamic function depends on internal and external states, is not well understood. A comprehensive understanding would necessitate the integration of single cell dynamics with their collective behavior at population level.

pmc-12606778.description: Simple SummaryOvarian cancer is the most lethal malignancy of the female reproductive system. Classification of benign and malignant ovarian masses before surgery is crucial for appropriate treatment. O-RADS category 4 ovarian masses often present atypical features, posing significant challenges to radiologists.

pmc-13369278.creator: Jingyu Xing, Hao Zhang, Zijie Yuan, Xinghao Cao, Tao Tan, Jinbo Hu, Wenlan Zhi, Chenglong Zhao, Cheng Yang
pmc-13369278.description: BackgroundPoorly differentiated chordoma (PDC) is an exceptionally rare bone tumor with aggressive behavior and early recurrence. Evidence on the role and integration of chemotherapy remains limited. We aimed to share our institutional management experience and identify clinical prognostic factors in PDC.

pmc-13617096.title: Dynamic γδ T-cell Receptor remodeling and antigen-induced T-cell IFN-γ responses after SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy: insights for γδ T-cell immunotherapy
pmc-13617096.creator: Yuhan Ke, Rongfeng Pan, Ling Li, Jing He, Yafang Li, Yuyuan Chen, Hongjie Liu, Jiawei Li, Muzi Luo, Rong Guo, Yan Chen, Danchun Chen, Chengfang Xu

pmc-13635746.description: The Kaposi’s sarcoma-associated herpesvirus oncoprotein vIRF3 is essential for primary effusion lymphoma (PEL) cell survival and cooperates with cellular interferon regulatory factor 4 (IRF4) to activate super-enhancers (SEs) controlling MYC and IRF4. However, the DNA sequence requirements for this cooperation are unknown.

uslaw-usc-t43-s421e.title: 43 U.S.C. § 421e — Municipal and industrial water supply delivery and distribution; allocation of loan funds; loan repayment contract requirements; rate of interest
uslaw-usc-t43-s421e.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s421e.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 12 (Reclamation And Irrigation Of Lands By Federal Government); Subchapter III (Institution And Construction Of Projects). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Unless otherwise provided in the Act authorizing construction of the project, the delivery and distribution of municipal and industrial water supplies shall be deemed to be an authorized project purpose under sections 421a.
